reuse.why: Computes expectedAmount with the existing shared getScheduledAmount, the same helper forecast, schedule-template and schedules/app already use for the expected amount.

duplication.why: No amount logic is written; the range/number/missing decision stays in the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in the api/schedules-get handler with a dedicated list type in api-models; putting it in scheduleModel.toExternal would centralise it further, but keeping it list-only matches the request.

scope.why: Only the list handler, its return type, the API test expectations and a release note change.

maintainability.why: A one-line mapping onto a shared helper with an explicit extended type is trivial to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses scheduleModel.toExternal for the existing fields and getScheduledAmount for the new one.
